rows.current: Modifies the specified annotations to the specified values. Supports expressions to combine existing annotations or generate new values.
rows.name: Set/Edit annotations

rows.current: Filters data based on the annotation value. Has two outputs, one that contains the data that matches the filter, and another output that contains all data that does not match the filter
rows.name: Filter by annotation (If else)

rows.current: Takes data items with text annotations, keeps only those that satisfy a boolean condition, and outputs the matching items with their annotations preserved. The condition can use annotation names as variables, for example checking that a dataset annotation contains Raw.
rows.name: Filter by annotation

rows.current: Copies annotations from the source data into the target data. This algorithm groups the incoming data based on the annotations. Those groups can consist of one data item per slot.
rows.name: Copy/overwrite annotations

rows.current: Executes a Python-script for each annotation row that allows redirection to a specified output slot (or to remove it). All annotations are passed as dictionary 'annotations' that can be modified using Python functions. The values are then extracted and converted into their respective JIPipe types. The target slot is extracted from a variable 'output_slot' that should be present within the script. If the variable is set to null or empty, the data is discarded.
rows.name: Split & filter by annotation (Script)

rows.current: Removes annotation columns that have missing values.
rows.name: Remove NA annotation columns

rows.current: Merges multiple annotations that are used for iteration step generation into a single annotation. Deletes or downgrades annotations that were involved in the merge.
rows.name: Simplify annotations
